decision: Source for the optimized intact cargo unit, not delivered itself: 284,422 triangles and 2048 WebP textures exceed Roblox limits. Copied unchanged from Cargo/sample_2026-09-27T182032.482.glb. Matches source/design-reference.png (Cargo unit 807ce1a0 variant 1, the white container with dark corner caps, end doors and ribbed long sides); variants 0 and 3 are a different, longer container and a latched hard case. The silhouette is a plain rectangular box and survives reduction, so this is optimized rather than rebuilt, using the method proven on assets/models/cargo: voxel remesh into one shell, planar dissolve, collapse, then bake colour/normal/roughness/metalness from this dense source. Tiling is rejected: this is a single hand-scale prop, not broad ground. Long axis arrives on Blender Y here, unlike the destroyed unit, so tools/blender/build_cargo_b.py rotates it onto X.
